policy.scope: NEURAL ONLY: neural GEMM, attention/transformers, language models, Mamba/Samba, RNN/LSTM/GRU, MLP/MoE, CNN/ResNet, neural GCN/GraphSAGE, embeddings, neural losses/optimizers and their native runtime. Excludes classical ML, classical forecasts, ANN/vector search, trees, clustering and Apple FAST tuning. Shared primitive changes must remain opt-in for named neural callers.
policy.identity: A and B may have different bits. Within each arm/version, NVIDIA, AMD, Apple and host must match bitwise wherever promised: outputs, gradients, fitted/state/checkpoint buffers, selection/stopping and errors. Changed arithmetic requires a coherent same-version host/device/forward/backward/decode contract, not an old-version equality gate.
policy.quality: No degraded quality is accepted. Use the repository's existing model-specific acceptance rules and full tasks: LM held-out loss/perplexity, classification/regression metrics, neural forecasting task loss, gradients/finite state and multi-step training stability. Numerical errors and identity alone do not establish task quality. Do not invent relaxed thresholds.
policy.scope_of_this_request: Generate ideas, then program opt-in source in this isolated worktree. Do NOT compile, run tests/checkers/static verification, execute candidate ML code, benchmark, rent machines, or update measured boards. All new switches default OFF. Source drafting is not qualification.
policy.future_measurement: Freeze one commit; reuse matching accepted compilation/identity evidence. Full-dataset/full-workload end-to-end A/B for every affected model on NVIDIA and AMD, one excluded warmup and one scored sample, vendors in parallel and cells serial per GPU. Include preparation, required synchronization and consumed outputs; distinguish fit/train, inference/prefill/decode, cold/repeated and complete default combinations. Component timings never qualify a default.
policy.promotion: Joint NVIDIA+AMD improvement with neither materially slower, required four-column identity and model quality preserved. Apple is an identity witness, never a timing vote for IDENTICAL. Preserve loser/neutral/failure/pending evidence and use board tools when actual measurements exist. No new default or merge to main from these uncompiled drafts.
policy.routing: No benchmark dimensions/names/seeds or near-board thresholds. Derive geometry/route/caps from work, bytes, supported hardware and numeric contract; explain in source. Cover adjacent shapes and a non-board dataset later. Removing a targeted rule uses old rule as B.
policy.runtime: All runtime data work is Mojo, GPU work stays on device for GPU routes; Python is API shell and experiment metadata/orchestration only. No Python arithmetic, loops/sorting/label work or worker threads in runtime.
policy.unsupported: Use supported Mojo/Modular features only. Record exact upstream asks if unavailable; no compiler-output rewrites, toolchain patches, unsupported modes or invented vendor instructions.
policy.resources: Future CPU arms use the full actual machine allocation, Linux cgroup allocation rather than host count, serial measurement arms and documented nested pools. Record effective worker pools; do not alter another active freeze.

interaction_rounds: NN01–NN16: GEMM physical schedule × arithmetic profile × workspace × grouped jobs × epilogues; isolate before the proposed complete configuration.
NN17/18/19/20/21/22/23: attention sharing, masks, saved state, softmax version and backward; measure a full layer and full train step.
NN24/25/26/27/28/30/31/32: norm arithmetic versus schedule, activation fusion, positions, caches, views and saved forward lifetime.
NN33–NN40: SSD tiles, scan/suffix/gradient profiles, decay reuse, causal pruning and generations; prefill/decode/backward must compose.
NN13/41/42/43/44: sequence GEMM, recurrent segments, gates, gradient profile and MoE grouping without changing dependent update order.
NN14/45/46/47/48: CNN lowering/fusion/gradients/statistics and neural graph operators, including host mirrors and full estimators.
NN49/50/51/52/53/54: embedding grouping, IDs, head/loss streaming and reduction; account for tied-weight gradient order.
NN55/56/57/58/59/60/61/62: optimizer status, group scalars, clipping, accumulation, RNG, aliases and arenas; full committed or failed step.
NN63/64 × NN03/04/20/24/34/38/39/43/54/57: versioned arithmetic must not accidentally depend on GPU count, batching or session routing.

experiments.prior_work: Reuse I01/A01/N01 and retained outcomes; caller coverage and attribution first.

experiments.quality_gate: Contraction words and all callers' full forward/backward outputs and task metrics.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject spills, extra launches, in-flight aliasing or a stack that depends on physical grid size.

experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject no credible throughput mechanism, precision reduction or incomplete migration of a caller/oracle.

experiments.title: Mamba immutable weight generations and workspace
experiments.arm_a: Use explicit owner/generation metadata to retain validated packed weights and bounded scratch until a weight/config mutation.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated full weight comparisons/copies and temporary allocations.
experiments.identity_contract: No Python data comparison/runtime work; all external mutation paths invalidate or take the safe uncached route.
experiments.quality_gate: Forward/decode/backward after update/load/reset, independent sessions and exception lifetime.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject pointer-only cache keys or silently trusting externally mutable buffers.
experiments.prior_work: Roadmap B10 and existing workspace infrastructure.

experiments.title: One-launch ordered recurrent inference/training segments
experiments.arm_a: Use supported within-task synchronization for bounded recurrent segments, batching independent sequences while keeping time steps ordered.
experiments.arm_b: One host-dispatched device operation per recurrent timestep.
experiments.identity_contract: Hidden/cell state and gate arithmetic exactly preserved; supported memory ordering must suffice without a compiler/runtime workaround.
experiments.quality_gate: All sequence outputs/states/gradients, ragged lengths, bidirectionality if supported, and model quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Park on unsupported ordering/launch capability; no cross-block spin barriers.
experiments.prior_work: Roadmap D2; existing FAST Apple scan is not IDENTICAL qualification.

experiments.title: Fuse recurrent gate pointwise updates
experiments.arm_a: Share projected gate loads for portable activation, state update and derivative-state stores in one task.
experiments.arm_b: Separate gate activation/state/derivative kernels.
experiments.identity_contract: Gate order, portable nonlinear functions, state dependencies and materialization rounding fixed.
experiments.quality_gate: Forward hidden/cell states, gradients and full recurrent model loss.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject different gate formulas or changed saved derivative semantics.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Versioned recurrent weight and bias gradients
experiments.arm_a: Fixed batch/time leaves and a canonical fold replace long sequential gradient reductions; separate dWeight and dBias arms.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent ascending reduction chains.
experiments.identity_contract: Host executor/oracle and device use exactly the new tree, masked-time rules and gradient accumulation ordering.
experiments.quality_gate: Gradient error, multi-step training loss, all optimizer state and padded/ragged sequences.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject skipping padded terms if old semantics require a signed-zero/nonfinite operation.
experiments.prior_work: An existing blocked weight-gradient profile is implemented. New arms change a declared leaf or schedule rather than claiming its first introduction.

experiments.title: MoE stable token grouping and grouped expert jobs
experiments.arm_a: Stable-group tokens by chosen expert and batch independent expert products, scattering outputs with original token order.
experiments.arm_b: Per-token/expert dispatch and repeated expert-weight loads.
experiments.identity_contract: Router scores, top-k ties, gate normalization, capacity and combine order unchanged; no dropped-token shortcut.
experiments.quality_gate: Router/expert outputs and gradients, expert skew, empty experts, overflow and task quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject sort/setup costs or reordered weighted expert sums.
experiments.prior_work: Reuse existing grouped/tiled MoE; isolate new scheduling geometry.

experiments.title: Fuse CNN activation/bias/residual passes
experiments.arm_a: Share convolution output loads for exact bias/activation/residual operations and save required backward masks in the same pass.
experiments.arm_b: Separate output passes and repeated mask creation.
experiments.identity_contract: Explicit rounded seams, activation-zero derivative policy and layout retained; no precision change.
experiments.quality_gate: Forward/gradients, residual branch behavior and full CNN classification quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject register/live-state growth or non-equivalent order of residual and activation.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Deterministic CNN gradient and pooling schedules
experiments.arm_a: Tile gather-style dInput and dWeight work, and fuse pool value/arg-index output; separately evaluate a versioned fixed dWeight tree.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent independent gathers/reductions and pooling passes.
experiments.identity_contract: Gather schedule keeps arithmetic order; tree variant is a separate version on all columns. Max ties/NaNs and overlap multiplicities fixed.
experiments.quality_gate: All gradients and pool indices, dilation/stride/padding tails and model quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unordered floating scatter-add or changed tie winners.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Neural BatchNorm statistics and running-state fusion
experiments.arm_a: Fuse independent statistic loads and normalization output; separately explore a versioned centered fixed-tree moment profile.
experiments.arm_b: Separate reductions, normalization and running-statistic passes.
experiments.identity_contract: Training versus inference, biased/unbiased variance uses, epsilon and momentum/running-count updates remain explicit and shared.
experiments.quality_gate: Statistics, outputs/gradients, running buffers and complete CNN loss; constant channels and small batches.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject cancellation from raw moments or updated running state on a failed step.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Neural graph aggregation tile reuse
experiments.arm_a: Share fixed CSR neighbor-feature tiles across output channels and fuse degree normalization at the specified point.
experiments.arm_b: Independent channel neighbor scans and separate normalization matrices.
experiments.identity_contract: Graph edges, stable neighbor order, reduction profile, self-loop and degree semantics unchanged; neural graph layers only.
experiments.quality_gate: Node outputs/gradients, isolated/skewed-degree nodes and graph-learning quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject neighbor sampling, graph sparsification or including classical PageRank in this lane.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Stable embedding grouping with touched-row gradients
experiments.arm_a: Use existing stable radix grouping and process touched rows; separately vary group task geometry and dense zero initialization.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent row scan/bitonic grouping path.
experiments.identity_contract: Token/original-position order, padding, duplicate multiplicity and accumulation semantics fixed; no floating atomics.
experiments.quality_gate: Dense gradient words and full neural step, all-same/unique/skew IDs and repeated calls.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject sort cost or excluding required dense output allocation/zeroing from timing.
experiments.prior_work: Reuse I11 actual candidates; new experiments must identify distinct geometry or caller coverage.

experiments.title: Reuse immutable token grouping across backward uses
experiments.arm_a: Retain canonical sorted IDs, position map and segments for an explicitly owned unchanged token batch.
experiments.arm_b: Rebuild the same grouping for each backward consumer.
experiments.identity_contract: Token owner/version, padding and vocabulary are cache keys; position order not inferred from a pointer or shape.
experiments.quality_gate: All embedding/head gradients, vocabulary changes, mutated IDs, repeated backward and accumulation.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unbounded caches or changing tied-weight gradient contribution order.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Resident token and target validation
experiments.arm_a: Validate immutable input IDs once in the native owner and pass explicit validated views to embedding/loss consumers; reuse bounded upload buffers.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated upload/readback and index scans in each consumer.
experiments.identity_contract: Validation must precede unsafe access; retain canonical first-invalid-index and refusal timing, invalidate on mutation.
experiments.quality_gate: Invalid IDs/targets, vocabulary tails, gradients, loss and repeated multi-step training.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject a caller-controlled trust flag used without a validation witness.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Cross-entropy elementwise pass fusion
experiments.arm_a: Share logits/max/exp loads for weights, target contribution and dLogits stores while preserving the denominator and reduction profile.
experiments.arm_b: Separate shifted-exp, target-weight and gradient elementwise passes.
experiments.identity_contract: Ignore index, label smoothing, reduction, weights and portable log/exp/div fixed; no approximate softmax.
experiments.quality_gate: Loss, dLogits, empty/ignored rows, extreme logits and full classification/LM quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject extra unrequested gradient work in inference or changed weighted denominator.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Stream LM head and exact loss without full logits
experiments.arm_a: Use bounded vocabulary panels, canonical row statistics and tiled backward, retaining or recomputing exact head pieces as separate arms.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize full logits and dLogits before loss and head backward.
experiments.identity_contract: The chosen profile fully specifies panel merges; if changed, all host/device/head/loss contracts move together. Requested full logits still materialize.
experiments.quality_gate: Loss/perplexity, all head/hidden/tied-embedding gradients, full optimizer state and memory capacity.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject sampled/adaptive softmax, fewer vocabulary items or scoring only the loss without required gradients.
experiments.prior_work: Extend existing chunked-head work with explicit same-version contracts.

experiments.title: Versioned loss reduction across tokens and microbatches
experiments.arm_a: Use a fixed logical token-leaf tree for loss numerator/weight sums, independently comparing a bounded streaming storage form.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent per-row/token reduction profile.
experiments.identity_contract: Same tree in host/all GPUs, explicit normalization/ignore/smoothing/zero-weight rules. Microbatch equivalence only where promised, with a defined merge.
experiments.quality_gate: Loss error, gradients, training trajectories and all degenerate-row refusals.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject accepting changed bits as proof of unchanged quality or hardware-dependent leaves.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Fuse optimizer post-update status production
experiments.arm_a: Emit per-block integer first-nonfinite records while update values are live, then reduce once in canonical field/index order.
experiments.arm_b: Rescan updated parameters and state in separate kernels.
experiments.identity_contract: Keep pre-access/pre-update checks, same failure step, field/index/message and commit/rollback behavior; only redundant output scans disappear.
experiments.quality_gate: Parameters, moments, counters, refusals and multi-step loss, including deliberately nonfinite gradients/states.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject partially committed failed steps or a later-step error report.
experiments.prior_work: Reuse I10 finish-scan design; full owner commit path is necessary.

experiments.title: Batch optimizer parameter groups with per-group scalars
experiments.arm_a: Precompute canonical step scalars once per group and use bounded group/tensor descriptors in one update grid.
experiments.arm_b: Per-tensor launches or repeated scalar calculation per element.
experiments.identity_contract: Respect per-tensor momentum initialization, group hyperparameters, bias correction, weight decay order and maximize semantics.
experiments.quality_gate: Every parameter/moment/step counter, heterogeneous groups, empty tensors and full model quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changed pow recurrence, epsilon placement or flattening away group semantics.
experiments.prior_work: Existing one-launch SGD is a foundation; new arms concern descriptor/scalar reuse.

experiments.title: Versioned global gradient-norm reduction
experiments.arm_a: Fixed logical leaves over the declared parameter/tensor order with a canonical norm fold; optionally fuse squared-gradient production with existing readers.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent per-tensor norms and scalar combination.
experiments.identity_contract: New profile shared host/GPU includes tensor order, squared-term rounding, sqrt, epsilon, clip comparison and nonfinite behavior.
experiments.quality_gate: Norms, clipped gradients, multi-step parameter trajectories and model task quality, especially clip-boundary cases.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject clipping each shard independently or changing tensor grouping without a new contract.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Fuse accumulation with gradient finishing
experiments.arm_a: Consume each produced gradient into the canonical accumulation buffer while emitting allowed status leaves, avoiding separate copy/add scans.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize gradient then separately add/scan it.
experiments.identity_contract: Microbatch and shared-parameter contribution order fixed, one explicit rounding at each old add, no unordered atomics.
experiments.quality_gate: Complete accumulated gradients and optimizer state over varied microbatch schedules and failures.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changing effective batch size, averaging order or reusing a buffer before its producer completes.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Fuse neural dropout RNG and pointwise consumers
experiments.arm_a: Generate the existing counter-indexed mask in its pointwise consumer and reuse exact mask coordinates in backward/replay.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize/read the entire mask or regenerate it in redundant separate passes.
experiments.identity_contract: Seed, step, layer, tensor coordinate and dropout scaling order unchanged; graph scheduling never consumes an RNG stream differently.
experiments.quality_gate: Masks, outputs, gradients, checkpoint reproducibility and training quality for p=0 and nonzero p.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changing stochastic semantics, probability, or omitting a publicly requested mask.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Parameter/gradient views with generation-safe ownership
experiments.arm_a: Bind native model and optimizer views to the same owned storage on supported vendors, refreshing after handle swaps.
experiments.arm_b: Copy all parameters and gradients at each step boundary.
experiments.identity_contract: Explicit alias/owner generation, mutation invalidation and synchronization; never silently enable an Apple-only assumption on other vendors.
experiments.quality_gate: Load/reset/step/serialize sequences, failed updates, tied weights, concurrent models and multi-step state.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unsupported buffer/view capabilities; record the exact Modular API ask.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: One final neural step status/readback boundary
experiments.arm_a: Accumulate safe device status fields and loss summaries for one final owner drain, retaining mandatory pre-access gates.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated intermediate status/loss readbacks and waits.
experiments.identity_contract: Canonical refusal priority and rollback/commit state remain identical; do not defer bounds checks that protect memory access.
experiments.quality_gate: Every success/failure state, correct step/counter, consumed outputs and full train quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject hidden CPU work, errors exposed late or removing lifetime barriers rather than replacing ownership.
experiments.prior_work: I10 supports pieces; complete public-step adoption remains its own experiment.

experiments.title: Live-range neural scratch and activation arenas
experiments.arm_a: Reuse disjoint-lifetime activation/gradient slabs within a bounded model/session arena; separate allocation and aliasing changes.
experiments.arm_b: Per-stage temporaries or overprovisioned high-water buffers.
experiments.identity_contract: Liveness includes pending device consumers, saved backward state, error paths and replay; all cells read are initialized.
experiments.quality_gate: Alternating model sizes, repeated inference/train, checkpointing, memory pressure and full outputs.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unbounded retention, inter-session aliases or moving allocation outside cold timing.
experiments.prior_work: I02 covers GEMM workspace; this extends model-wide liveness.

experiments.title: Deterministic neural multi-device shard merge
experiments.arm_a: Batch transport and merge canonical logical gradient leaves in one prescribed global order, preserving a single-device equivalent profile where promised.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent shard transport/merge schedule.
experiments.identity_contract: Device count/topology may schedule transfer but cannot redefine arithmetic leaf membership; no nondeterministic library collective as an identity substitute.
experiments.quality_gate: Full global gradients, clip norms, optimizer state and model quality; uneven shards and failure cleanup.
experiments.rejection_conditions: If supported Mojo communication/ordering is missing, park and request it; no unsupported transport workaround.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.

experiments.title: Neural inference state batching with isolated sessions
experiments.arm_a: Batch independent inference sessions/requests with explicit per-session cache/state lengths and gather/scatter descriptors.
experiments.arm_b: Separate launches and repeated model-weight staging per request.
experiments.identity_contract: Each request retains its own token order, cache/hidden state, RNG and arithmetic profile; length buckets follow work/bytes only.
experiments.quality_gate: Every request's logits/state against its own sequential execution, reset/cancel/tails and task quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject cross-session contamination, changed padding arithmetic or latency regressions hidden by aggregate throughput.
experiments.prior_work: New extension; inspect existing switches before implementation.
